prompt: Why would ordering by the model code alone be unreliable in this case?
promptZh: 本案為何不能只靠型號訂購？

options.text: The homeowner cannot read the cabinet’s code.
options.zh: 住戶看不清楚櫃子的型號。

options.text: The cabinet has a non-original front whose hole spacing should be used.
options.zh: 櫃子換了非原廠面板，該用實際孔距來選。
options.whyZh: 表單特別要求自行更換面板要提供實測值，住戶確實換過。

options.text: None of the available pulls comes in the original finish.
options.zh: 三款把手都沒有原本的表面處理。
options.whyZh: 比對卡說三款都提供原本的款式。

options.text: The homeowner wants to replace the entire cabinet.

explanationZh: 表單特別要求自行更換面板要提供實測值，住戶確實換過。
evidence: My Lark 80 drawer front was replaced by a local cabinet shop last winter. | The model code alone may identify the wrong pull.

vocabulary.note: 用來識別產品，但未必代表換修後的孔位。

difficultyRationale: 對照住戶換過面板的事實與表單對新孔位的警告。
